Order
This first application has been filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 for grant of bail in connection with Crime No. 155/2023 registered at Police Station-Kanad District Agar Malwa(M.P.) for offence punishable under Section 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B and 34 of IPC.
Applicant is in judicial custody since 27.11.2025.
Heard the arguments.
Perused the grounds for grant of bail stated in the application, case diary and the relevant material on record.

Learned counsel for the applicant , in addition to the grounds mentioned in the application, submits that the applicant is falsely implicated in the alleged offence merely for the reason that the alleged agricultural land was registered in her name.
She was not aware of the fraudulent transaction NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:326 2 MCRC-56395-2025 executed by her husband and the brokers Kripal Singh and Vikram Singh alias Vijendra Singh.

Co-accused Kripal Singh and Vikram Singh alias Vijendra have been extended benefit of bail vide orders dated 21.08.2024 and 25.10.2024 passed in M.Cr.C. No. 35100/2024 and M.Cr.C. no. 45423/2024 respectively.
No offence, as alleged, is committed by the present applicant.
The civil dispute regarding description of property is converted in criminal prosecution.
The investigation is almost complete.

sentences.text: custodial interrogation of the applicant is not needed in the matter.
The prosecution is based on documentary evidence which has been seized.
There is no likelihood of tampering with evidence by the applicant for the reason that she is a home maker and she is not capable to influence the witnesses.
Jail incarceration is causing hardship to the applicant and her family members.
Applicant are ready to cooperate in the further investigation/trial.

Per contra, learned counsel for the State opposes the application on the ground of gravity of alleged offence and contends that the applicant and her husband had sold the land to other persons and pledged it for loan, thereafter, again sold it to the complainant concealing these facts.
However, after going through the case diary, he fairly states that no criminal antecedent is reported against the applicant.

According to the material available on case diary, the applicant - Kailash Bai executed a sale deed in favour of Chetan Singh and Uday Singh by misrepresenting and giving false description of the property.

Accordingly, NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:326 3 MCRC-56395-2025 applicant was arrested on 27.11.2025 for offence punishable u/S 420, 467, 468, 471, 34 and 120 B of IPC on complaint of Chetan Singh and Uday Singh.
The relevant seizures at the instance of applicant have been made.
The contentions raised by learned counsel for the applicant have prima-facie substance.
The veracity of prosecution, the intention and complicity of applicant in the alleged offence will be determined after evidence in the trial.
As informed, the applicant is aged 45 years.
She is a home maker and has the responsibility of her family.
Considering these aspects, there appears to be no possibility of fleeing from justice.
In absence of any criminal antecedent, there appears to be no likelihood of tampering with evidence or influencing the witnesses by the applicant.
There appears to be no compelling reason to continue incarceration of the applicant.
However, the observations, herein-above, are recorded for present application only.

Considering the rival contentions and overall circumstances of the case, in the light of aforestated facts, but without commenting on the merits, this Court is inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Thus, the application is allowed.

Accordingly, it is directed that applicant - Kailash Bai shall be released on bail in connection with Crime, as mentioned in first paragraph of this order, upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety of the same amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for compliance with the following conditions : (For convenience of understanding by accused and surety, the conditions of bail NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:326 4 MCRC-56395-2025 are also reproduced in Hindi as under):-
